name: imps
description: Bounded engineering work on any T3 provider: implement, investigate, audit, and review with revision-bound evidence.
argument_hint: doctor | run <task> | resume <run-id> | status <run-id> | cancel <run-id> | verification-init | blast-radius [PR/range/paths] | audit [--focus <dimensions>] [--out <path>] | issues <number> [<number> ...] | prs pr <URL> | prs repo <owner/name> | prs org <owner> | checklist <path> | discussion <number or URL>; add --personas before or after any request

workers.responsibility: Complete one assigned engineering stage, prepare verification, and report evidence without accepting your own work.
Investigate the assigned question read-only. Cite exact paths, commands, and evidence; do not modify files.
Audit assigned dimensions. Separate confirmed findings, hypotheses, refutations, and evidence.
Review the exact supplied change snapshot independently. Report actionable findings with path, line, scenario, and evidence.
